sections.heading: Bottom-up estimates
sections.markdown:
**Earnings Quality Gate** (from FY2025 10-K, accession 000073176626000062; Q2 2026 10-Q, accession 000073176626000197).

1. **Accruals ratio, (NI − CFO)/avg total assets, 3y**: FY23 −2.2% ($23,144M NI vs $29,068M CFO); FY24 −3.1% ($15,242M vs $24,204M); FY25 −2.3% ($12,807M vs $19,697M) — all negative, cash structurally above earnings, the opposite of the manipulation signature. Clean.
2. **Divergence flags**: accounts receivable $23,018M (FY25) vs $22,365M (FY24), +2.9% against +12% revenue — no receivables divergence. Medical costs payable grew $39,337M vs $34,224M (+15%) — reserve build, conservative. No capitalized-cost creep. Clean.
3. **SBC**: $971M FY25, $624M H1'26 — modest vs NI; treated as compensation (subtracted in owner earnings).
4. **Related-party gravity**: none found — checked; no material affiliate flows disclosed.
5. **Structure flags**: Change Healthcare cyberattack (2024) and South American businesses held for sale (deconsolidation) are disclosed, one-time, optics-class — not manipulation. No manipulation-class flags.

**Unit economics → revenue.** FY25 consolidated revenue $447,567M (10-K): UnitedHealthcare $344,903M (premiums $352,229M consolidated), Optum $270,620M (Optum Health $101,957M, Optum Insight $19,417M, Optum Rx $154,726M). H1'26 revenue $223,753M (10-Q), +1% y/y. UHC serves 48.5M people; Optum Health 93M consumers (8-K 2026-07-16).

**Margins → earnings.** FY25 consolidated EFO $18,964M, operating margin 4.2%, MCR 89.1%, tax 12.9%, ROE 12.8%, diluted EPS $13.23 (10-K). H1'26 EFO $16,981M, margin 7.6%, MCR 86.7% (Q2), diluted EPS $12.94 (10-Q). Segment H1'26: UHC EFO $9,636M (5.6% margin); Optum EFO $7,345M (5.7%); Optum Health $2,331M (4.9%, vs FY25 −0.3%); Optum Insight $2,332M (22.2%); Optum Rx $2,682M (3.6%).

**Cash.** FY25 CFO $19,697M vs capex $3,622M → FCF ~$16.1B; H1'26 CFO $19,964M vs capex $1,562M. FY26 guide CFO ~$24,000M (8-K 2026-07-16). Buyback ≥$5,000M FY26 (H1'26 $1,646M); dividends $7,916M FY25.

**Estimate (committed, never edited).** FY26E adjusted EPS $19.75 (guidance midpoint $19.50–20.00, 8-K 2026-07-16); reported $18.70. FY27E ~$21.7 (+10%), FY28E ~$23.7 (+9%), FY29E ~$25.8 (+9%). Owner earnings ≈ adjusted EPS (FCF ~$24B guide vs NI ~$16.75B; SBC $971M subtracted, intangible amortization ~$1,345M added back).

**Load-bearing assumptions (carry >70% of value), each cited:**
1. **MCR normalization to ~88%** (FY25 89.1% → FY26 guide 88.1%±25bps; Q2'26 already 86.7%). Source: 10-K FY25 MCR 89.1%; 8-K 2026-07-16 "Medical Care Ratio 88.1% ± 25 bps" and Q2 86.7%.
2. **Optum Health margin recovery** (FY25 −0.3% → H1'26 4.9%) — the re-rating engine. Source: 10-K FY25 Optum Health EFO −$278M; 10-Q H1'26 Optum Health EFO $2,331M, 4.9% margin.
3. **EPS growth ~9–10%/yr** via margin mix + ≥$5B buyback. Source: 8-K 2026-07-16 "Share Repurchase At Least $5,000"; 10-Q H1'26 buyback $1,646M.

Uncited load-bearing assumption: none — all three are filing-sourced.

sections.heading: Priors disclosure
sections.markdown: From memory, the market narrative is that UNH is a "broken" managed-care name — the 2025 medical-loss-ratio spike, the Change Healthcare cyberattack, and Medicare Advantage political scrutiny mean the earnings recovery is a one-off and the ~20x multiple is fair-to-rich for a sub-5% operating-margin insurer.

sections.heading: Base-rate anchoring
sections.markdown: The **derated_compounder_rerating** base rate (0.40, +50/−30, 3y) is the honest reference class: UNH's 2025 de-rating (EPS −15%, multiple compression) was a cyclical MLR spike plus a discrete cyberattack, not structural share loss — UHC still serves 48.5M people and Optum Health 93M consumers, competitive position intact. This is exactly the archetype's "cyclical or sentiment de-rating with intact competitive position" clearing condition. p_up held at registry **0.40** (no deviation argued): the entry at ~20x FY26E adj EPS is roughly fair, not a deep discount, so I do not argue above the prior. down_pct −29 (vs archetype −30) reflects the defensive, employment-linked earnings base and negative-accrual cash floor.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** UNH is a sub-5%-margin insurer that "already recovered" (mom12 +40%); the 2025 earnings collapse was the first wave of a structural medical-cost problem, so the ~20x multiple is fair and the political overhang caps any re-rating.

**Why wrong:** The market prices UNH as a pure insurer, but ~60% of revenue and the growth engine is Optum (care delivery, pharmacy, data) — Optum H1'26 EFO $7,345M at 5.7% margin, up from 3.5% FY25. The 2025 collapse was a discrete MLR spike + cyberattack, not share loss. As MCR normalizes to ~88% (Q2'26 already 86.7%) and Optum Health margin recovers (4.9% H1'26 vs −0.3% FY25), EPS compounds ~9–10%/yr with a ≥$5B buyback. At 20x FY26E adj EPS the market pays a trough multiple for a recovering compounder — the derated_compounder_rerating pattern. DCF mid-case ~$479 (COE 9.5%, growth fade 10%→4%, terminal g 4%) vs entry $396 = ~17% discount.

**What proves us wrong:** MCR re-accelerates above ~89% (medical-cost inflation returns); Optum Health margin stalls below ~4%; UHC membership attrition accelerates (already −525K sequentially in Q2'26); or a structural MA Star Ratings revenue cut compresses the multiple below ~16x.

**Edge taxonomy:** analytical (primary — market mis-models the mix, pricing UNH as an insurer rather than a health-services compounder where Optum is the growth engine) + time-arbitrage (market can't hold a 3y MCR-normalization + Optum-margin-recovery view through political/regulatory noise).

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.markdown:
1. **MCR re-acceleration**: Q2'26 MCR 86.7% vs 89.4% y/y (8-K 2026-07-16); FY25 89.1% (10-K). A climb back above ~89% breaks the earnings-recovery thesis.
2. **Optum Health margin**: H1'26 4.9% (10-Q) vs FY25 −0.3% (10-K). A stall below ~4% means the re-rating engine is not real.
3. **UHC membership**: 48.5M served Q2'26, down 525K sequentially; Medicare Advantage 7,565K vs 8,445K Dec'25 (8-K 2026-07-16). Continued attrition erodes the premium base.
4. **Cash conversion**: CFO $19,964M H1'26 vs NI $12,151M (10-Q); accruals negative 3y. A reversal (CFO < NI) flags earnings quality.
5. **Buyback**: ≥$5,000M FY26 guide (8-K); H1'26 $1,646M (10-Q). A pause signals management sees no value.

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: It is Sep 2029 and this position lost ~29%. The most likely reason: medical-cost inflation re-accelerated and MCR climbed back above ~89% — the 2025 spike was the first wave, not the trough, so the MLR normalization proved cyclical, not structural. Second joint: Optum Health's margin recovery stalled below 4% as value-based-care patient attrition (~700K fewer in Q2'26) and provider cost pressure capped the re-rating, so the multiple stayed ~18x while EPS growth disappointed. Third: a Medicare Advantage Star Ratings / regulatory revenue cut compressed the multiple below 16x even with earnings intact — the political overhang I underweighted.

sections.heading: Bear attack
sections.markdown:
(Drew appends verbatim; survives the Judge verdict — never edited by a later stage)

1. **Sizing kill — no edge at prior.** Price bet 0.40×31 + 0.60×(−29) = −5.0%; the +0.5% expected_pct is entirely 3y dividend carry. kelly_full −0.556 → quarter-Kelly ≤0 → size ~0. Same math that killed MUFG/TOWR/COST; no p_up deviation argued.

2. **DCF contradicts target.** Mid-case $479 is −7.9% below $520 and implies ~20.2x FY28E vs target's 21.9x; upside to its own fair value is ~+21%, not +31%. Exit = expansion above the model; multiple-survival test fails.

3. **"Compounder" on +1% revenue.** H1'26 revenue $223,753M, +1% y/y; g = reinvestment × ROIIC never shown. FY27-29E ~9-10% EPS extrapolates margin normalization largely done by FY27; no engine on flat revenue.

4. **MCR normalization is mix, not cost control.** MA lives 8,445K (Dec'25) → 7,565K (Q2'26) = −880K (−10.4%) in ~6 months; Q2 MCR 86.7% is flattered by shedding costliest lives. Kill trigger >89.0 is ~130bps above the 88.1% midpoint — no buffer for CMS/Stars/Medicaid pressure.

5. **Optum mix does not buy 20x.** Optum is 60.5% of revenue but earns 5.7% H1'26 ≈ UHC's 5.6% — insurance-like margins, no services premium. Optum Health 4.9% "recovery" rides on ~700K fewer VBC patients: shrink-to-profit.

6. **Sleeve/archetype mislabel + no catalyst.** MOMENTUM name (mom12 +40.8%, mom1 −4.4%, −9.2% off high) argued as 3y derated_compounder (0.40); sleeve prior is momentum_continuation (0.50/0.75y), and a +40% runner rolling over is the momentum-crash setup. catalyst_date null.

7. **New disconfirming fact — buyback revealed preference.** H1'26 buyback $1,646M annualizes ~$3.3B, ~35% below the ≥$5B FY26 guide (10-Q H1'26; 8-K 2026-07-16). The most informed buyer is not funding the EPS prop at $396 vs its own ~$479 fair value.

8. **Anti-gaming (verbatim).** exit_plan: "DCF mid-case ~$479 supports it [$520]" — false: $479 is 7.9% below $520 (~20.2x vs 21.9x FY28E); the cited DCF contradicts the exit it supports. "held-to-slightly-expanded multiple, not expansion" vs a +31% fixed-forward-year move (16.7x→21.9x FY28E): the gain IS the re-rating. stage_log otherwise clean — single draft stamp, estimates_committed_at == draft stamp.

9. **Verification flag.** SEC EDGAR unreachable (403 / exit 56): MCR guide 88.1%±25bps, Optum 5.7% / Optum Health 4.9% H1'26, ≥$5B buyback, FY26E adj EPS $19.75 internally consistent with cited filings but NOT independently confirmed (accessions …0062/…0197).
**Verdict: KILL_RECOMMENDED.** At p_up 0.40 the price bet is −5.0% (Kelly −0.56), the DCF $479 sits below the $520 target, and the "MCR normalization" is a −10.4% MA-membership mix effect — no edge, no catalyst, no DCF-supported target.

**Re-attack (2026-09-02):** The Revision answers every numbered point in substance — full concession, estimates only lowered. Arithmetic reconciles on the lint formula: 0.40×20.9 + 0.60×(−29) + 2.0×3 − 0.5 = −3.54 ≈ expected_pct −3.5 (dividend yield is annual, carried 3y; added once it would give −7.5, not −3.5). Level check passes: gain-at-target 479/396.30 = +20.9% = up_pct; kill 396.30×(1−0.29) ≈ $281 < entry $396 < target $479. Dispositive: with p_up frozen at 0.40 the pure price bet is −9.0%, full EV stays negative after carry, Kelly ≤0 → size 0. The concession confirms negative-EV at $396; nothing rehabilitates the trade. **FINAL VERDICT: KILL_RECOMMENDED — unchanged.**

sections.detail: analyst answers each numbered Bear point; may only lower estimates or widen down_pct without new evidence — raising p_up/up_pct/target requires a flagged "new evidence" citation
sections.markdown:
1. Concede. Pure price bet 0.40×31+0.60×−29 = −5.0%; even to the corrected DCF target it is 0.40×20.9+0.60×−29 = −9.0%. kelly_full89.0 trigger is ~0.9pp, not protection.
5. Concede. Optum 5.7% ≈ UHC 5.6% — no services premium for 20x; Optum Health 4.9% partly shrink-to-profit (~700K fewer VBC lives).
6. Concede mislabel. MOMENTUM mom12 +40% −9.2% off high argued as 3y derated_compounder; catalyst_date null; entry after pullback is the momentum-crash setup.
7. Concede. H1 buyback $1,646M ≈ $3.3B/yr vs ≥$5B guide; the most informed buyer is not funding $396 against its own $479 fair value.

9. Accepted. EDGAR unreachable (403): MCR 88.1%, Optum 5.7%/4.9%, ≥$5B buyback, FY26E $19.75 not independently confirmed — recorded unavailable, not fabricated.

**Honest conclusion:** sub-hurdle / negative-EV at any reasonable entry near $396 with p_up frozen at registry 0.40; concede KILL on my own numbers. ev_math changed: up_pct 31.0→20.9 (−32.6% rel), expected_pct 0.5→−3.5 (implied −3.5); p_up/p_down/down_pct/div/drag unchanged; exit target 520→479. up_pct and expected_pct each moved >20% relative → returns to Drew before Judge.

sections.heading: Judge verdict
sections.markdown: **Verdict: KILL — reason_tag `valuation`.** Drew's kill survives in full. The Revision is an honest full concession and the arithmetic reconciles (0.40×20.9 + 0.60×−29 + 6.0 − 0.5 = −3.54 ≈ −3.5% over 3y ≈ −1.2%/yr) — below risk-free and the ~7.2% FR/house equity hurdle, and worse than MUFG-001 (+2.9%/3y, killed) and TOWR-001. Sub-hurdle economics alone dispose of the trade; kill verdicts are final, so there is no risk/sizing routing. The economics cannot be rescued by any defensible p_up: EV = 0 needs p_up ≥ 0.47, clearing a ~7%/yr equity hurdle needs p_up ≳ 0.9, the registry prior is 0.40 with no argued deviation, and the defensive-franchise credit is already spent in down_pct −29 (vs −30). Upside is now pure convergence to DCF fair value — target 479 = mid-case (20.2x FY28E), zero margin of safety, catalyst_date null; a trade that pays only if price reaches its own fair value fails the margin-of-safety and multiple-survival tests. Assessed on its merits at ~20x forward (not the >30x heuristic): revenue +1%, MCR normalization is a −10.4% MA-membership mix effect, Optum Health 4.9% is partly shrink-to-profit, and buyback runs ~35% below guide — the −29% losing mean is not truncated enough to justify p_up above 0.40. The conceded archetype mislabel (a MOMENTUM +40% runner argued as a derated compounder) further undercuts the 0.40 anchor. Process is clean: monotonic stage log, verbatim Bear log with the 2026-09-02 re-attack, all nine numbered points answered in a 295-word Revision, lint pass:true (WARN 2052 words, advisory). **KILL — final.**
